scope: User requested completion of remaining Phase2 evaluations and higher useful GPU concurrency on 2026-09-13; no changes to checkpoints, scientific protocol, 8 logical shards, seeds, prompts, model precision or gold locking.
ownership: Use idle GPUs or GPUs occupied exclusively by this scheduler's real workers; never terminate foreign processes or fill memory with dummy tensors.
checkpoint_boundary: 250GiB pre-training rule is unchanged; already-committed model evaluation uses 200GiB reserve plus 20GiB remaining write allowance.
retry: Only GPU OOM in read-only measurement/evaluation is automatically retried. Completed trajectories and committed shards are preserved. Other errors stop with audit.
